components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--brand); color:var(--on-brand); font:700 1rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--brand-hover); color:var(--on-brand); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border:1.5px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); font:700 1rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--brand); color:var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Current navigation link
components.description: A readable link with a coral current-page rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-current { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:.5rem .1rem; border-bottom:2px solid var(--brand); color:var(--ink); font:800 1rem/1.65 Nunito,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-current:hover { color:var(--brand-ink); } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Raised invitation
components.description: A single bordered surface without a shadow.
components.css: .ds-invitation { padding:1.3rem 1.5rem 1.4rem; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius-panel); background:var(--surface-raised); color:var(--ink); font:600 1.5rem/1.2 Fraunces,Georgia,serif; }

components.name: Selected store choice
components.description: The surrounding link treatment for an inferred matching store; official badge artwork stays in the page.
components.css: .ds-store-selected { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:196px; min-height:76px; padding:12px 16px; border:2px solid var(--brand-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-panel); background:var(--band); color:var(--ink); font:700 1rem/1.2 Nunito,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-store-selected:hover { background:var(--band); } .ds-store-selected:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand-ink); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: The website uses the app's own cream, plum, coral, and teal palette and its two typefaces. Warm surfaces and a restrained editorial serif give the rider's history space; clear Nunito text keeps actions and details easy to scan. Real app captures carry the product imagery.
dos: Do use the existing CSS custom properties and self-hosted Nunito/Fraunces faces when extending the website.
Do preserve real app captures and legible light and dark states.
donts: Don't put white text on the coral action fill or use the raw teal accent as small text on cream; the existing ink and link variants address contrast.
